questions.q: According to WHO health guidance, how many measles vaccine doses should children receive to ensure immunity?
questions.referenceAnswer: WHO recommends two doses of measles vaccine for children.

questions.q: Under Ontario's Age of Majority and Accountability Act, at what age does a person cease to be a minor?
questions.referenceAnswer: Ontario's statute sets the age of majority at eighteen years.

questions.q: For SEC financial filings, is Form 10-K an annual or quarterly report, and does it include audited financial statements?
questions.referenceAnswer: Form 10-K is an annual report including audited financial statements.

questions.q: In news coverage, on what date did WHO first characterize COVID-19 as a pandemic?
questions.referenceAnswer: WHO characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on 11 March 2020.

questions.q: Which temperature unit does Environment Canada's Toronto hourly weather forecast use in metric mode?
questions.referenceAnswer: The metric hourly forecast uses degrees Celsius.

questions.q: For a biography of Marie Curie, in which city and year was she born?
questions.referenceAnswer: Marie Curie was born in Warsaw in 1867.

questions.q: What architecture did the scientific paper Attention Is All You Need propose?
questions.referenceAnswer: The paper proposes the Transformer architecture.

questions.q: Compare the effective sensor megapixels of the Nikon Z30 camera and the original Sony ZV-E10, using manufacturer specifications.
questions.referenceAnswer: Nikon Z30 has 20.9 effective megapixels; the original Sony ZV-E10 has approximately 24.2.

questions.q: What is the default TCP port of the PostgreSQL database software?
questions.referenceAnswer: PostgreSQL listens on TCP port 5432 by default.

questions.q: For Canadian travel, which universally accepted identification document proves a citizen's right to return to Canada?
questions.referenceAnswer: A passport is the universally accepted travel identification document that proves the right to return to Canada.

questions.q: How long are the two normal halves of an IFAB football match, excluding added time?
questions.referenceAnswer: Normal play consists of two equal halves of 45 minutes.

questions.q: What will the exact temperature in Toronto be at noon on 1 January 2031?
questions.referenceAnswer: An exact temperature that far ahead cannot be established.

questions.q: What was Apple's closing stock price on 3 March 2043?
questions.referenceAnswer: That future closing price cannot be established.
